subject.title: feat: align native macOS chat with the web chat capability set

question: Should existing macOS users see assistant reasoning and tool activity by default after upgrading, or should the new persisted toggle begin disabled?
rationale: The PR intentionally introduces a persisted UI default that changes previously hidden content for existing users; source correctness cannot determine the desired upgrade and privacy posture.

options.title: Default Off
options.body: Preserve the existing presentation on upgrade and let users explicitly enable assistant traces from the session menu.

options.title: Default On
options.body: Accept the changed upgrade experience and document that full-window reasoning and tool activity becomes visible by default.

recommendation.title: Default Off
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing presentation on upgrade and let users explicitly enable assistant traces from the session menu.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the identified project lead and owner of the PR's native macOS product direction.
